_comment: Canonical mobile-operator table — the SINGLE source of truth for operator identity. Read by the manager (domain/operators.js) at runtime and by scripts/generate.py at instance-generation time. Keeping one file means the op-shim NAME (baked at container creation from op_name) and the RIL numeric MCC/MNC can never disagree: both come from the same row. mnc is a string to preserve leading zeros; mncLen is derived from it.
